rationale.text: A visible select in a form holds optgroup elements without a label attribute. The test asks whether each optgroup has a label attribute, and it names no other way and no exception. The custom check faults these optgroups (step 7) through a link whose fault means failure, so the finding is failed at both levels.

citations.quote: Dans chaque balise `<select>`, chaque balise `<optgroup>` possède-t-elle un attribut `label` ?
Pour chaque élément `<optgroup>`, vérifier qu’il possède un attribut `label` ;
